title: 第26章 隐锋尽出劫魔裂心第27章 劫外棋动道心新章
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、四象战阵·仁权合璧
沈墨卿与云湛共掌「仁剑杀劫阵」，惊鸿剑的仁道金丹与青霞断水剑的剑魂共鸣，在明心院废墟上空凝结出「仁」「权」双色剑气。
楚轩行的虚影突然从劫火中踏出，手中「权」字笔残片与剑阵核心对接：
「沈墨卿，试试「仁权四象」——以仁道为盾，以权术为矛！
-招式·仁权四象·诛邪：
剑气化作青龙（仁）、白虎（权）、朱雀（劫）、玄武（心），分别镇守东南西北，竟将劫魔的劫火长城切割成四块。
萧素雪的劫外茶席·关键助攻
她在忘忧谷茶树下摆开「四象茶阵」，测天丝心镜丝勾连三派弟子的道心：
-云湛的仁剑簪吸收「劫外茶气」，剑势更具韧性；
-昙无音的业火红莲在茶香中长出净魔莲叶，净化效率翻倍；
-洛青璃的太虚丹剑注入茶露，丹爆威力提升三成。
凌九霄的民愿驰援
他站在希望长城上，举起社稷锄高声疾呼：「民为邦本，本固邦宁——今日，吾等为「人」而战！
」大胤百姓的愿力化作金色麦穗，穿透劫魔的劫外黑雾，为四象战阵提供源源不断的能量。
二、劫魔反噬·隐阵危机
劫魔察觉隐世阵法的威胁，背后十二对劫界羽翼同时震动，竟将中天棋盘的「劫」字碎片全部吸入体内，化作「万劫归一环」套在脖颈：
「隐世小儿，以为凭三派残阵，能阻吾灭世？」
-技能·万劫归一·蚀：
环中喷出黑色蚀雾，接触者的道心印记会被强行篡改为「劫」字，云湛的仁剑簪、昙无音的业火红莲相继出现裂纹。
洛青璃的丹爆陷阱

她算准蚀雾轨迹，在粮仓上空布下「太虚丹阵」：「以丹为雷，以阵为引——爆！
」十二颗返魂丹同时炸开，蚀雾竟被炼化成「清浊合剂」，反而修补了希望长城的缺口。
昙无音的佛魔同陨
面对被蚀雾污染的劫奴，他突然露出悲悯笑容：「贫僧今日，行「杀度」之道！
」佛魔双身法相自爆，业火红莲与灭度锡杖化作千万光针，钉入劫魔的灭世图腾：
「此身即魔，此心即佛——劫魔，受业！
三、楚轩行·逆心终爆
魔体内的「逆心种子」因昙无音的自爆产生连锁反应，楚轩行的意识趁机占据劫魔左臂，竟挥刀斩向其心脏：
「太昊玄渊，吾之「权术」，从来不是为了臣服——是为了……颠覆！
-关键道具·魔罗睺残片：
碎片化作「魔权之刃」，在劫魔胸口刻下「逆」字符文，与其体内的「劫」字棋激烈对冲，竟撕开半透明的道心屏障。
沈墨卿的仁道抉择
他抓住机会，以仁道金丹引动四象战阵，剑气贯穿道心屏障，却见劫魔体内蜷缩着太昊玄渊的本源意识——那是个被困在劫字棋中的少年：
「原来……你才是真正的「劫囚」。
云栖鹤隐的现世·茶破万劫
劫外茶树突然开花，云栖鹤隐的骸骨在茶香中重组，手持「劫外生」棋子踏入战场：「太昊玄渊，吾等了三百年——该让劫棋……散局了。
content_en:
1. Four Symbols Battle Formation: Combination of Benevolence and Power
Shen Moqing and Yun Zhan jointly mastered the "Benevolent Sword Killing and Tribulation Formation". The benevolent golden elixir of the Jinghong Sword resonated with the sword soul of the Qingxia Duanshui Sword, and the two-color sword energy of "Benevolence" and "Quan" condensed over the ruins of Mingxinyuan.
Chu Xuanying's shadow suddenly stepped out of the calamity fire, and the fragment of the "quan" pen in his hand connected with the core of the sword formation:
"Shen Moqing, try the "Four Symbols of Benevolence and Power" - use benevolence as a shield and power as a spear!
-Moves·Four Symbols of Benevolence and Quan·Zui Xie:
The sword energy turned into Qinglong (Ren), White Tiger (Quan), Suzaku (Jie), and Xuanwu (Heart), guarding the southeast, northwest, and actually cut the Jie Demon's Jie Huo Great Wall into four pieces.
Xiao Suxue’s Tea Party·Key Assist
She set up the "Four Symbols Tea Array" under the tea trees in Wangyou Valley, and measured the Taoist hearts of the disciples of the three sects connected by Tiansi Heart Mirror Silk:
-Yun Zhan's Ren Sword Hairpin absorbs the "Jie Wai Tea Qi", making the sword's power more resilient;
- Tan Wuyin's Karma Fire Red Lotus grows demon-purifying lotus leaves in the fragrance of tea, doubling the purification efficiency;
-Luo Qingli's Taixu Dan Sword is infused with tea dew, and the power of the Dan Explosion is increased by 30%.
People from Ling Jiuxiao are willing to rush to help
He stood on the Great Wall of Hope, raised his hoe and shouted loudly: "The people are the foundation of the country, and the foundation is the foundation of the country. Today, we are fighting for "people"!
"The wishes of the people of Dayin turned into golden ears of wheat, penetrating the black mist outside the calamity demon, and providing a steady stream of energy for the Four Elephants Battle Formation.
2. Demonic backlash and hidden array crisis
The calamity demon sensed the threat of the hidden world formation, and the twelve pairs of calamity world wings behind him vibrated at the same time, sucking all the fragments of the word "Jie" on the Zhongtian chessboard into his body, and turned them into a "ring of all calamities" to put around his neck:
"Young kid from the hidden world, do you think you can stop me from destroying the world with the remnants of the three sects?"
-Skills·All Calamities Return to One·Eclipse:
Black corrosion mist is sprayed out from the ring, and the Taoist mark of the person who comes into contact will be forcibly tampered with the word "tribulation". Yun Zhan's Renjian Hairpin and Tan Wuyin's Karma Red Lotus have cracks one after another.
Luo Qingli's Pill Explosion Trap
She accurately calculated the trajectory of the mist, and set up the "Taixu Pill Formation" over the granary: "Use the pill as thunder, use the formation as a detonator - explode!"
"Twelve soul-returning pills exploded at the same time, and the mist was refined into a "pure and turbid mixture", which instead repaired the gap in the Great Wall of Hope.
Tan Wuyin's Buddha and Demon Die Together
Facing the Jie slaves polluted by the mist, he suddenly showed a compassionate smile: "Today, the poor monk practiced the method of "killing"!
"The twin bodies of the Buddha and the Demon exploded. The Red Lotus of Karma and the Tin Staff of Destruction turned into thousands of light needles, nailing into the Totem of the Destroying Demon:
"This body is a demon, this mind is a Buddha - rob the demon and receive the karma!
3. Chu Xuanxing·Rebellion finally explodes
The "Heart-Reverse Seed" in the demon's body caused a chain reaction due to Tan Wuyin's self-destruction. Chu Xuanying's consciousness took the opportunity to occupy the left arm of the demon and actually slashed at his heart with a knife:
"Taihao Xuanyuan, my "power" is never for submission - it is for... subversion!
-Key props·Marahu fragments:
The fragments turned into the "Blade of Demonic Power" and carved the character "Inverse" on the chest of the robbery demon. It fiercely clashed with the character "Jie" in his body, and actually tore open the translucent barrier of Taoist heart.
Shen Moqing's benevolent choice
He seized the opportunity and used the golden elixir of benevolence to activate the Four Symbols battle formation. The sword energy penetrated the barrier of the heart of the Tao, but he saw the original consciousness of Taihao Xuanyuan curled up in the body of the robbery demon - it was a young man trapped in the robbery chess:
"It turns out...you are the real "Prisoner".
The Appearance of Yunqi Heyin·Tea Breaks Ten Thousand Calamities
The Jiewai tea tree suddenly bloomed, and the bones of Yunqi Heyin were reorganized in the fragrance of tea. He stepped into the battlefield holding the "Jiewai Sheng" chess piece: "Taihao Xuanyuan, I have been waiting for three hundred years - it's time to let the Jiewai chess... end.
